title: Sughra Sughra
body:
khafila aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam se chut kar aaye haram
thay mehwe buka ba-deeda e nam
in ujde huwe logon ke khareeb
jab pahunchi binte shaahe umam
ek ek chehre ko takti thi
aur karti thi bemaar fughan
akbar hai kahan asghar hai kahan
ammu hai kahan baba hai kahan sajjad kahan
sughra se sun kar naam apna
sajjad ye ro kar kehne laga
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra sughra pardes mein ghar barbaad hua
balon ki safedi dekh zara
sadmon se mera ye haal hua
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra mai bataun kya tujhko
kya beet gayi maqtal jaa kar
ashoor ka suraj le aaya
zainab ke ujad jaane ki khabar
abbas aur akbar na rahe
ek din mein sabhi ko aayi qaza
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar meri roti hi rahi
mai baap ki nusrat kar na saka
maqtal se uthi halmin ki sada
jhoole se gaya baysheer tera
ek teer laga bejaan hua
maqtal se ye di baba ne sada
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke kaleje se barchi
jis waqt shahe deen ne khaynchi
tu apna muqaddar dekh zara
us waqt mili tehreer teri
akbar ko dekha ro diye
tehreer ko dekha aur ye kaha
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sughra tere ammu ki qasam
jab tak tha fiza mein unka alam
phupiyon ke saron pe chadar thi
lachaar nahi thay ahle haram
reti pe gira jis waqt alam
besaakhta dil ne nauha kiya
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal thay sadmon se baba
uth'te thay kabhi gir jaate thay
ek laash utha kar laate thay
ek laash uthane jaate thay
kabhi qasim ke tukde laaye
kabhi aun o mohamed ka laasha
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir asr ka wo hangaam utha
marne ko chala jab baba tera
nau laakh ka lashkar tha sughra
aur tanha khade thay shaahe huda
baba ki shahadat kaise hui
mai tujhko nahi batla sakta
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir shaam ghareebon ki aayi
maqtal mein andhere chaane lage
maqtal ke andheron mein zaalim
qaimon ko jalaane aane lage
durr cheene gaye aur chadarein
zehra ka chaman taraaj hua
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar gaye darbaar gaye
ye gham jeete ji maar gaye
zindan mein sakina jab bichdi
hum log bhi himmat haar gaye
ro ro ke haram ye kehte thay
ab kaisi rehaai kya jeena
sughra sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar ye bayan aasaan nahi
farhan ke aansu behne lage
ghash khaane lagi sughra sun kar
sajjad bhi ro kar kehne lage
mar jaati sughra tu sun kar
as-shaam agar samjha deta
sughra sughra...
author: Mazhar Abidi
